inquiry.body:
Hello,

I am interested in learning whether I may be eligible for the study "Autologous Stem Cell Therapy in Patients With Multiple System Atrophy" (NCT07465198, https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT07465198).

About me:
- Diagnosis: multiple system atrophy, cerebellar type (MSA-C)
- Year of symptom onset: 
- Age: 
- Location (city/country): 
- Treating neurologist: 

Could you tell me about next steps for screening?

Thank you,
inquiry.subject: Inquiry about participating in NCT07465198

interventions.description: IV infusion of 200,000,000 of neuroinduced mesynchimal stem cells at week 1 of the trial period
interventions.name: MSCs

interventions.description: Intravenous 0.9% saline infusion, volume- and appearance-matched
interventions.name: Placebo

official_title: A Phase II Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Study of Autologous Stem Cell Therapy in Patients With Multiple System Atrophy
summary: This study investigates the safety and efficacy of autologous stem cell therapy in patients with Multiple System Atrophy (MSA), a rare and progressive neurodegenerative disorder characterized by autonomic failure, parkinsonism, and cerebellar ataxia. The trial will evaluate functional outcomes, motor performance, and quality of life compared to placebo/controlled group.
title: Autologous Stem Cell Therapy in Patients With Multiple System Atrophy
